title: Kimchi Jeon (Kimchi Pancake)
description: Savory kimchi and scallion pancake, pan-fried until crisp.
instructions:
FOR THE DIPPING SAUCE:

Simmer all ingredients in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened and reduced to about ¾ cup, about 5 minutes. Let cool completely before serving.

FOR THE PANCAKE:

Whisk flour, egg white, and reserved kimchi juice together in large bowl. Stir in scallions and kimchi until well combined.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add pancake batter and spread into even layer with rubber spatula. Cook until well browned around edges, about 4 minutes. Run spatula around edge of pancake and shake skillet to loosen. Slide pancake onto large plate.

Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in now-empty skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Invert pancake onto second large plate, then slide it, browned side up, back into skillet. Cook until pancake is well browned on second side, about 4 minutes. Slide pancake onto cutting board, cut into wedges, and serve with dipping sauce.

ingredients.raw: ¼ cup (1¼ ounces/35 grams) all-purpose flour

ingredients.item: cabbage kimchi, drained with 2 tablespoons juice reserved
ingredients.raw: 1 cup cabbage kimchi , drained with 2 tablespoons juice reserved, chopped coarse

ingredients.item: scallions, white parts sliced thin, green parts cut into 1-inch lengths
ingredients.raw: 4 scallions , white parts sliced thin, green parts cut into 1-inch lengths
